sn_aia_skill_metadata.description: Fetch real-time stock data, latest news, and generate actionable insights for a given company. This agent is designed for the Ultratech CLM portal to help evaluate vendors and third parties by analyzing market trends, financial performance, and recent developments. It provides a concise summary along with risk and stability assessment to support contract lifecycle and business decision-making.
